questions.question:
The radius of a hemisphere is 14 cm. What is the cost of painting the outer curved surface of the hemisphere at the rate of Rs. 45 per cm²?

( {{{Take pi }} = {{ }}frac{{22}}{7}} )
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Radius of hemisphere = 14 cm.

**Calculation:**

Outer surface area of a hemisphere is 2πr²

So, outer surface area of hemisphere = 2 × 22/7 × 14² cm²

⇒ 1232 cm²

⇒ The cost of painting = 1232 × 45

∴ **The cost of painting the outer surface of hemisphere is Rs. 55440**

questions.question: 60% of a number is 168, then what is the number?
questions.solution:
Let the number be x

According to question,

x × 60% = 168

⇒ x × 3/5 = 168

⇒ x = 280

∴ The required number is 280.

questions.question: The speed of a boat in still water is 6 km/h. Time taken by the boat to cover a certain distance upstream is 3 hours more than the time taken to cover the same distance downstream. If the speed of the stream is 2 km/h, then what is the total distance (upstream and downstream) covered by the boat?
questions.solution:
Given, the speed of boat in still water is 6 km/hour

And the speed of stream is 2 km/hour

⇒ The speed of boat in downstream = 6 + 2 = 8 km/hour

And the speed of boat in upstream = 6 – 2 = 4 km/hour

Let the fixed distance be x km

Now, according to question

x/4 = 3 + x/8

⇒ x/4 – x/8 = 3

⇒ x/8 = 3

⇒ x = 24

⇒ The total distance covered by the boat in upstream and downstream = 24 × 2

∴ The total distance is 48 km

questions.question: E, F and G together can complete a work in 12 days and E and F together can complete the same work in 30 days. Then in how many days can G alone complete the same work?
questions.solution:
Work done by E, F and G together in 1 day = 1/12

And, work done by E and F together in 1 day = 1/30

⇒ The work done by G in 1 day = 1/12 – 1/30 = 1/20

∴ The time taken by G to do the whole work is 20 days

questions.question: The proportion of the number of students in three classes is 1 : 2 : 3. If 20 students are included in each class, then the proportion becomes 3 : 5 : 7. What was initially the total number of students in the three classes?
questions.solution:
Let the ratio be x

So, number of students in three classes are x, 2x and 3x

According to question,

Increased number of students in three classes are (x + 20), (2x + 20) and (3x + 20)

And the given proportion of increased students is 3 : 5 : 7

So, are (x + 20)/ (2x + 20) = 3/5

⇒ 5x + 100 = 6x + 60

⇒ x = 40

So, the total number of student in the class initially = x + 2x + 3x

⇒ 6x

⇒ 6 × 40

⇒ 240

∴ The total number of students in the class initially was 240

questions.question: A sum of Rs. 2000 is invested on simple interest for three years at the rate of 10% per annum, then what will be the amount?
questions.solution:
Since, Amount = P + (P × R × T/100)

⇒ Amount = 2000 + (2000 × 10 × 3/100)

⇒ Amount = 2000 + 600

∴ Amount after three years will be Rs. 2600

questions.question: Marked price of an article is Rs. 2600, which is 30% more than the cost price. If the profit is 45%, then what will be the selling price of the article?
questions.solution:
Since, Marked Price = Cost Price × 130%

⇒ 2600 = Cost Price × 13/10

⇒ Cost Price = 2000

So, Selling Price = Cost Price × 145%

⇒ Selling Price = 2000 × 145/100

∴ The Selling Price of the article will be Rs. 2900

questions.question: A sum of Rs. 1000 is invested on compound interest (compounding annually) for three years. If the rate of interest is 10% per annum for the first two years and 50% per annum for the third year, then what will be the interest?
questions.solution:
Amount after 3 years = 1000 × 110% × 110% × 150%

⇒ Amount = 1000 × 11/10 × 11/10 × 3/2

⇒ Amount = Rs. 1815

So, the interest earned = Amount – Principal

⇒ The interest earned = 1815 – 1000

∴ The interest after 3 years will be Rs. 815

questions.question: What is the largest two digit number which when divided by 6 and 7 gives remainder 3 and 4 respectively?
questions.solution:
The largest two-digit number is 99

So, divide it by the L.C.M of 6 and 7, that is 42

⇒ We can write 99 = 42 × 2 + 15

⇒ The largest two-digit number divisible by 42 is 84

∴ The largest two-digit number which when divided by 6 and 7 gives remainder 3 and 4 respectively is 84 – 3 = 81

questions.question: The difference in selling prices of an article when sold at 15% profit and 17% loss is Rs. 96. If it is sold at 10% profit then what is the selling price?
questions.solution:
Let the cost price of the article be Rs. x

Selling price when sold at 15% profit = 115x/100

Selling price when sold at 17% loss = 83x/100

According to question,

⇒ 115x/100 – 83x/100 = 96

⇒ 32x/100 = 96

⇒ x = 300

So, the selling price when sold at 10% profit = 300 × 110%

∴ The selling price when sold at 10% profit is Rs. 330

questions.question: The cost price and the selling price of a shirt are Rs. 960 and Rs 1392 respectively. If by way of bargaining a customer can bring the selling price down by 10% of the cost price, then what is the profit percentage?
questions.solution:
Given, the cost price of shirt is Rs. 960

And the selling price of shirt is Rs. 1392

According to question,

Discount = 10% of cost price

⇒ Discount = 960 × 10% = 96

⇒ The new selling price = 1392 – 96

⇒ 1296

⇒ The new profit percentage = (1296 – 960)/960 × 100%

∴ The profit percentage is 35%

questions.question: The area of a square is 144 cm². What is the perimeter of the square formed with the diagonal of the original square as its side?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

The area of a square is 144 cm².

**Formula used:**

Area of square = (side)²

Perimeter of the square = 4 × side

**Calculation:**

Let the length of side of square be a cm

Given, the area of square = 144 cm²

So, a² = 144

⇒ a = 12

The length of diagonal = √2 × 12

⇒ 12√2 cm

The length of side of new square is 12√2 cm

The perimeter of new square is 4 × 12√2

**∴ The perimeter of new square is 48√2 cm.**

questions.question: What is the value of 16 ÷ 48 × 12 + 4 ÷ 8 × 16 + (7 - 2) × 25 ÷ 15?
questions.solution:
Follow BODMAS rule to solve this question, as per the order is given below:

Step-1: Parts of an equation enclosed in 'Brackets' must be solved first and in the bracket,

Step-2: Any mathematical 'Of' or 'Exponent' must be solved next,

Step-3: Next, the parts of the equation that contain 'Division' and 'Multiplication' are calculated,

Step-4: Last but not least, the parts of the equation that contain 'Addition' and 'Subtraction' should be calculated.

16 ÷ 48 × 12 + 4 ÷ 8 × 16 + (7 - 2) × 25 ÷ 15 = ?

⇒ ? = 16 ÷ 48 × 12 + 4 ÷ 8 × 16 + 5 × 25 ÷ 15

⇒ ? = 1/3 × 12 + 1/2 × 16 + 5 × 5/3

⇒ ? = 4 + 8 + 25/3

⇒ ? = 12 + 25/3

∴ ? = 61/3

questions.question: The average weight of 18 boys in a group is 35 kg. If four new boys of weights 20 kg, 22 kg, 26 kg and 28 kg are added to the group, then what is the approximate average weight of the newly formed group?
questions.solution:
Sum of weights of 18 boys = 18 × 35 = 630

After joining four new boys,

Total weights of 22 boys = 630 + 20 + 22 + 26 + 28 = 726

⇒ The new average = 726/22

**∴ The new average will be 33 kg.**

questions.question: Ravi’s age is 3/5 of Shyam’s ages. After x years the ratio of the ages of Ravi and Shyam becomes 5 : 7 If initially the sum of their ages is 32, then what is the value of x?
questions.solution:
Let the present age of Ravi and Shyam be 3r and 5r respectively

According to question,

3r + 5r = 32

⇒ 8r = 32

⇒ r = 4

So, their present ages are 12 and 20

Now, again according to question

(12 + x)/(20 + x) = 5/7

⇒ 84 + 7x = 100 + 5x

⇒ 2x = 16

∴ The value of x is 8

questions.question: What is the difference of mean and median of the given data: 4, 13, 8, 15, 9, 21, 18, 23, 35, 1 ?

1, 4, 8, 9, 13, 15, 18, 21, 23, 35

⇒ Mean = 14.7

And median = (13 + 15)/2 = 14

So, the required difference = 14.7 – 14

∴ The difference between mean and median of the above data is 0.7

questions.question: Vishal alone can complete 1/3 part of a work in 60 days and Ashok alone can complete 1/4 part of the same work 30 days. In how many days Vishal and Ashok together can complete the same work?
questions.solution:
Since, work done by Vishal in 60 days is 1/3 part of the work

⇒ The work done by Vishal in 1 day = 1/180 part of the work

⇒ The work done by Ashok in 30 days = 1/4 part of the work

⇒ The work done by Ashok in 1 day = 1/120 part of the work

⇒ The work done by Vishal and Ashok together in 1 day = 1/180 + 1/120 ⇒ 1/72

∴ The time taken by them to complete the whole work is 72 days.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] **__Shortcut Trick__**

Total time to complete the work by Vishal = 180 days 

Total time to complete the work by Ashok = 120 days 

Let total work be 360 units (l.c.m of 180 and 120)

Efficiency of Vishal = 360/180 = 2 units/day 

Efficiency fo Ashok = 360/120 = 3 units/day 

Efficiency of (Vishal + Ashok) = 5 units/day

⇒ The time taken by Vishal and Ashok together to complete the work is 

360/5

⇒ 72 days

**∴ The time taken by them to complete the whole work is 72 days.**

And the third proportion of 12 and 6√5 is (6√5 × 6√5)/12

⇒ 15

⇒ The required ratio is 60 : 15

questions.question: A train with 72 km/h speed crosses a stationary pole in 35 seconds. How much time (in minutes) does it take to cross a 1.1 km long bridge?
questions.solution:
Given, speed of train = 72 km/hour = 20 m/second

Let the length of the train be x m

According to question,

⇒ x = 20 × 35

⇒ x = 700m

And again according to question,

⇒ 1100 + 700 = 20 × time

⇒ Time = 1800/20 = 90 seconds = 1.5 minutes

∴ The required time to cross the bridge is 1.5 minutes.
